summary.intent: Complete pre-PR quality work on phase 43 (feat/fuse-write-durability): run CodeRabbit review, verify/fix all 8 critical findings from the existing review doc, run /simplify, capture deferred todos, ship the PR, and resolve all review comments.
summary.outcome: PR #487 created and all review threads resolved. All 8 phase-43 criticals verified fixed in code (CR-03/CR-04 required live fixes this session); 3 simplify cleanups and 3 CodeRabbit review-body fixes applied; 6 deferred refactor todos captured; Rust crate coverage wired into codecov; sync edge-trigger logic extracted and unit-tested.

repo: After `gh pr create`, release-please bot (`github-actions[bot]`) immediately pushes a `chore(release): set release targets` commit to the PR branch, causing the next local push to be rejected — must `git fetch` + `git rebase` before retrying.

winfsp code cannot be compiled locally on macOS; all Windows-path edits must be verified by CI (`cargo check --features winfsp` gate in ci.yml:557–605) and by inspection against the compile-checked fuser path.

The `desktop` codecov flag (`apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**`) was silently discarding all Rust crate coverage; `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` already collects it — only a second upload under a `rust` flag (`crates/**`) was needed.

Phase 43 branch contained ~22 phase-42 commits that appeared in git log but contributed zero net diff against `origin/main` because phase 42 was already squash-merged via PR #485; comparing against local `main` showed a false diff.

CodeRabbit review body comments marked 'outside diff range' and 'nitpick' do not create resolvable inline threads — they live in the PR review body as collapsed `<details>` sections and must be addressed by pushing fixes + replying to the review.
The GSD `/gsd:ship` workflow blocks on `verification.status != passed`; the check reads `*-VERIFICATION.md` via `gsd_run query verification.status`.
The Entire CLI pre-push hook runs a checkpoint sync that can take 1-3 minutes and must be waited on before confirming push success.

code.finding: CR-03 residual: the child IPNS key journal wrap fell back to `encrypted_ipns_for_tee.clone().unwrap_or_default()` on wrap failure, journaling a TEE-wrapped key in the user-key field — replay can't unwrap it. Fixed to warn + `String::new()` (parks instead of bricks).

CR-03 residual (winfsp path): same TEE-key fallback in the child IPNS key journal wrap. Also: lines 148/152/886 called `cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` while the rest of the file uses `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` (re-export of same fn, but inconsistent).

CR-04: inode mutations (`inode.kind`, `pending_content`, `queue_publish`) occurred before `journal.put` — a prepare failure left mutated state and an already-queued publish. Fixed by deferring all three mutations to after the journal fsync commit point.

Parent and file IPNS key journal wraps silently fell back to empty string with no log — same degradation class as CR-03. Fixed to `warn!` + `String::new()` at all 6 IPNS-key wrap sites across read_ops.rs and windows/write_ops.rs.

Case-sensitive `"not found"` string match in replay first-publish detection — a reworded error silently flips the branch. Fixed to `.to_lowercase().contains("not found")` as a mitigation; full typed-error refactor deferred to a captured todo.
Variable `depth` and constant `MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH` actually counted nodes visited during vault tree traversal, not depth. Renamed to `nodes_visited`/`MAX_RESOLVE_NODES` for accuracy.

Duplicated per-variant `sort_by_key` match on `JournalOp` to extract timestamp. Fixed by adding a `created_at_ms()` accessor method on `JournalOp`. Also: journal test had a no-op `plaintext_probe.contains()` assertion (the string was never inserted); replaced with a meaningful assertion that raw key bytes don't appear in the serialized entry.
`TrayStatus::WriteParked` was missing from `is_connected()`, causing the Logout menu item to be disabled for an authenticated user with parked uploads — user could not log out.

`spawn_sync_daemon` had no idempotency guard; calling it twice (re-auth / IPC) would spawn two concurrent daemon loops, doubling every status update and WriteParked notification — directly undermining the D-10 anti-spam work.

The `SyncStatus`→`TrayStatus` bridge and D-10 edge-trigger decision (notify only when `failed > prev`, reset on Idle) were inlined in the daemon closure with zero test coverage. Extracted into a pure `bridge_status()` function with 8 unit tests that lock down the anti-spam invariants.

workflow: When verifying critical findings after a series of fix commits, don't trust commit messages — dispatch parallel read-only agents per finding to verify against actual current code; at least one 'fixed' finding (CR-03) was still live.
1Password SSH signer can wedge with 'failed to fill whole buffer' after a failed signing attempt; recovery requires quitting and relaunching the 1Password desktop app before retrying the commit.
CodeRabbit re-finds your own documented criticals live in the code — treat this as a signal that commit-message coverage claims need code-level verification.

For `/simplify` passes on security-sensitive code (CR-04 ordering, winfsp journal paths), defer large consolidations that require changes to un-compilable platform code; apply only pure, behavior-preserving wins and capture the rest as todos.
The GSD `verification.status` gate reads the planning doc literally — if UAT was done but not recorded, the ship workflow blocks. Record UAT results in the VERIFICATION.md before running `/gsd:ship`.
When a PR branch predates a squash-merge of an earlier phase, the commit list looks polluted but the net diff is clean; `git diff origin/main...HEAD` (not local `main`) shows the true PR scope.

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged twice with 'failed to fill whole buffer' — required restarting the 1Password app; cost ~3 failed commit attempts and manual intervention.
GitHub connectivity outage (port 443 timeout after 75s) during push mid-session; required a connectivity check before retrying.
After `gh pr create`, the release-please bot commit immediately caused a push rejection; required fetching, identifying the bot commit, and rebasing before the push succeeded.
winfsp code is not locally compilable on macOS — all Windows-path edits had to be verified by inspection and CI, with no local type-check possible.
Local `main` ref was stale post-phase-42 squash-merge; diffing against it showed a falsely large PR scope until the comparison was switched to `origin/main`.
The combined commit+push command did not confirm push completion in its output; had to separately verify branch sync state after each operation.
open_items: Consolidate the duplicated fuser↔winfsp upload + mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods — highest-value refactor, security-sensitive ordering must be preserved, needs winfsp CI gate.

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with `Option<String>` uniformly plus a `wrap_ipns_key_for_journal` helper — `parent_ipns_key_hex` uses sentinel while `file_ipns_key_hex` already uses Option.

Extract shared journal-dir path and `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` helper — currently triplicated across `fuse/mod.rs`, `fuse/windows/mod.rs`, and `commands/sync.rs`; a mismatch would silently break crash recovery (CR-07 footgun).

Have `replay_upload_entry` delegate to `operations::publish_file_metadata` and extract a shared `cas_publish_parent` helper — replay re-inlines ~110 lines also present in write_ops.rs and windows/write_ops.rs.
Memoize `resolve_folder_key` during `replay_for_vault` — currently re-walks the vault tree from root per replayed entry; super-linear replay latency when multiple entries share a parent folder.

Replace string-matching `e.to_lowercase().contains("not found")` in replay first-publish detection with a typed `Result<Option<u64>>` or `NotFound` variant from `resolve_sequence` — touches 9 call sites and `PublishCoordinator`.
winfsp CI gate is the first real compile verification of the CR-03/CR-04/simplify edits on the Windows path — watch the CI run on PR #487.
Replay code (journal load, IPNS publish, CAS-parent) has no unit test coverage and is hard to test without network stubs — acknowledged but not addressed this session.

The last commit in the session (3 CodeRabbit review-body fixes: daemon idempotency, nodes_visited rename, no-op test fix) was being committed and pushed at transcript end — verify it landed on the PR branch.
